title: Vector values from a list segment
statement: Let $t,n$ be natural numbers, let $I$ map each index in $\{0,\ldots,t-1\}$ to an index in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\mu$ be an integer-valued memory function. If the segment of $\mu$ beginning at $a$ equals the length-$t$ list whose $k$th entry is the integer represented by $I(k)$, then for every $k<t$, the memory value at $a+k$ equals the integer represented by $I(k)$.
hypotheses_covered: The memory segment beginning at $a$ equals the list of integer values of $I$
